title: day
summary: A familiar time word and a tempting Roman clue.
question: Does the Roman word explain English day?
completion: Day follows Old English dæg. German Tag is a cousin. Latin diēs looks promising, but it is not the source of English day.
partner: A familiar word can carry a surprising history. Follow the evidence!
